sentences.text: Radotina was an extinct genus of placoderm, a type of armored fish, that lived in Europe during the early Devonian period.
The genus Radotina was first described by Gross in 1950.
There are currently only two recorded fossil occurrences of Radotina.
This animal belongs to the family Radotinidae and is classified within the class Placodermi.
Radotina lived between 419.62 and 410.62 million years ago, spanning the Lochkovian to Pragian stages.
